articles.title: transfer rumours: Vardy to West Ham? Madrid move for Zubimendi?
articles.dek: Today’s rumours are just trying to orbit the sun When did the summer of 2026 transform into a midfield merry-go-round? Now Bruno Guimarães has rocked up at Arsenal and…
articles.description: Today’s rumours are just trying to orbit the sun When did the summer of 2026 transform into a midfield merry-go-round? Now Bruno Guimarães has rocked up at Arsenal and Manchester United have a couple of new signings, it stands to reason that more midfielders will be on the move soon and Real Madrid appear to be chasing Gunners metronome Mart ín Zubimendi .
